column4: Attacker used Tor browser — IP tracing very difficult. Need to analyze attack patterns.
HBL security team cooperating fully. Provided server access within 2 hours.
Phishing domain registered only 24 hours before attack — typical throwaway technique.
Jazz IT team slow to respond. Escalated to their CISO directly.
FBR refused to pay ransom. Good decision. Backup restoration underway.
Ransomware entered through unpatched Windows Server 2016. Patch management failure.
NADRA audit shows 2300 citizen records accessed without authorization.
Telenor breach possibly linked to insider. Still investigating internal access logs.
MCB attack from same IP range as UBL attack in December 2023.
USB ports should have been disabled on all government PCs. Security policy failure.
APT group signature matches Lazarus Group techniques. Possible state sponsored.
Zero day exploit extremely sophisticated. Likely purchased from dark web.
Bilal Nawaz had financial debts. Competitor bank may have paid for customer data.
Two arrested suspects revealed ring operating for 8 months across 4 cities.
